parameters.content:
## 📋 How This Workflow Works

This is a personal tool, not a shared app — every credential below is tied to the original builder's own accounts. To reuse this workflow yourself:

1. Duplicate this workflow into your own n8n account
2. Replace every credential (see ⚠️ badges on canvas)
3. Re-activate (Publish) before it will run automatically

**What it does:** searches live LinkedIn-sourced job postings, ranks them with Claude against your stated interests, and delivers results via a Telegram bot you message directly or a daily scheduled digest.

⚠️ NEEDS YOUR OWN CREDENTIAL

RapidAPI key (Header Auth) — sign up at rapidapi.com and subscribe to JSearch. This key is billed to whoever owns it.

⚠️ USES SHARED WORKSPACE CREDITS

This Claude call runs on the n8n workspace's own AI Gateway credits — it does NOT transfer if someone duplicates this workflow into a different n8n account. They'll need to connect their own Anthropic credential.

⚠️ NEEDS YOUR OWN CREDENTIAL

Telegram Bot token (from @BotFather) + your own chat ID. Messaging this bot only works for whoever owns the bot token connected here.
